name: Matthew
bio: Matthew, a tax collector, was sitting at his collection booth when Jesus called him to follow; he immediately got up and followed, then hosted Jesus and his disciples at his house along with many other tax collectors and sinners, drawing criticism from the Pharisees that Jesus answered by saying he had come to call sinners, not the righteous (Matthew 9:9-13). Tradition credits him as the author of this Gospel. Mark's account of this same calling names him Levi, son of Alphaeus (Mark 2:14-17).
